Sophie (CSM): Heads-up — Solara's token usage dropped 68% in last 14 days. Also saw a new domain in our webhook logs: competitor-demo.solara.io. Flagging renewal risk. Anyone on this?

Drew (Account Exec): On it. Renewal due 2026-07-02 per CRM. Reached out yesterday, no reply. I'll ping Rahul (they were looped earlier).

Sophie (CSM): @Rahul can you confirm if procurement still aligned? We had steady seat expansion in Q1.

Rahul (Product Lead - Solara): Sorry team — we swapped PMs last week. New PM (Lina) is running a 30-day shadow trial with a small vendor (no purchase yet). Procurement asked for an RFP and a security checklist. :grimacing: 

Marta (CS Ops): Do we have a current security checklist + SOC doc link? I can send immediately.

Drew (Account Exec): Yes — sending pack and a tailored TCO note. Also asking for a competitive-play summary. If Lina wants a demo, we can offer a focused session and a short trial with Dedicated.

Sophie (CSM): Recommend a low-effort enablement session focused on prompt templates and evaluation metrics. Quick wins can slow churn. Also request the specific evaluation prompts they're using from Lina — that will help us match metrics.

Rahul (Product Lead - Solara): Lina wants a live demo + recorder for their procurement review. Also asked for response-time bench (95th pct) and sample outputs for 3 seed prompts. Can we produce that by EOD Friday?

Marta (CS Ops): Have a prebuilt 'procurement pack' we can adapt. ETA 48 hours to tailor. Will attach SOC and encryption KMS notes.

Drew (Account Exec): I'll table a commercial concession for the trial if they timeline to decision < 6 weeks. Need approval from RevOps — looping @Sophie for exact usage numbers.

Sophie (CSM): Usage export attached: last 30d by route. Key observation: read-only embedding calls are flat, gen traffic dipped after their last API key rotation. Could be a token routing issue or product reprioritization.

engage-bot: Reminder: scheduled check-in with Solara set for 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Use /cs-check to update.

Rahul (Product Lead - Solara): Thanks — can we do the demo next Tue 2026-04-28? Lina's available 15:00 UTC. We'll share their eval prompts by Monday morning.

Sophie (CSM): Booked for Tue 15:00 UTC. Agenda: 20m demo, 20m Q&A (security/procurement), 10m technical handoff. I'll prepare a tailored output sample and latency bench.

Drew (Account Exec): I'll draft a 4-week pilot agreement with a 10% trial discount and optional escalation clause. Will cc RevOps.

Marta (CS Ops): :thumbsup: I'll send procurement pack + SOC to Rahul, cc Sophie. Also request procurement point-of-contact and procurement timeline.

Rahul (Product Lead - Solara): PC: procurement@solara.com (Mark). Timeline: RFP closes 2026-05-06. Lina wants final commercial terms by 2026-05-04. Appreciate quick turnaround.

Sophie (CSM): Understood. Action list: Marta send docs today; Sophie produce outputs and latency bench by Mon EOD; Drew draft pilot terms by Mon noon; Drew to get RevOps approval; Rahul to share Lina's prompts. Let's sync after docs sent. :eyes: 

Drew (Account Exec): Acknowledged. Will update thread with RevOps ok/no later than Mon 13:00 UTC.

Sophie (CSM): :notes: quick note — recommend enabling prefix caching for their gen routes during trial to reduce cost and show consistent latency. We can toggle for trial.
